verdict.rationale: Statsig's docs show attribute-based targeting on feature gates: changing the experience based on attributes like username or email, targeting mobile platforms and internal testers, and layering multiple targeting rules with overrides. Nothing in the pack documents reusable segments, so only half the story is evidenced. Missing for 10: reusable segment definitions shared across flags, detailed documentation of rule operators and attribute types, independent or hands-on corroboration of targeting behavior.

support.subject: As a developer, I can target flags with attribute-based rules and reusable segments so the right users see the right variation

citations.quote: Modify the user experience based on attributes like username, email, or other identifiers
You can also layer multiple targeting rules and set overrides to force specific users into a variant for testing or QA.
This tutorial creates a feature gate, targets mobile platforms and internal testers
A feature gate controls who sees a new feature and rolls it out gradually without deploying code.
